name: rfid-ntag
title: RFID Spool Reader
author: bespoked
description: USB RFID reader picks up OpenSpool-encoded NTAG215 cards. Writes the current spool's metadata to rfid_data.json on every card event so the rest of the stack just knows.
tagline: NTAG215/OpenSpool RFID: your filament knows what it is.

variables.name: RFID_FORCE_GENERIC_VENDOR
variables.description: True to report every non-Snapmaker spool to slicers as brand Generic with no sub-type, so Snapmaker Orca can match it. False to report the brand written on the tag.

config.label: Show my spools in Snapmaker Orca
config.hint: On: your loaded spools appear under Machine Filament in Snapmaker Orca, listed as Generic plus the material, because those are the only filament names Orca can match. The printer's own screen shows Generic too. Off: the brand written on the tag is used everywhere, and Orca lists nothing for anything but Snapmaker spools.

conflict_resolutions.description: FW <=1.4.0.38 uses ppins GPIO (not gpiod); different patch context required for fm175xx_reader.py
FW <=1.4.0.38 uses copy.deepcopy; different patch context required for filament_detect.py

attributions:
# Attributions - rfid-ntag

**Plugin author:** Bespok3d, with parts of the Extended Firmware overlay `13-patch-rfid`, OpenRFID there by @suchmememanyskill and the OpenSpool `subtype` field by @morgendagen

Reads NTAG filament tags on the printer's built-in reader.

| Upstream project | Author | Licence | Needed at runtime | Code ships in this package |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OpenSpool tag format | the OpenSpool project | published format | no | no |
| Extended Firmware overlay `13-patch-rfid` | @suchmememanyskill and @morgendagen, packaged by paxx12 | GPL-3.0 | no | yes |

The patches in this plugin modify Snapmaker's own firmware files on the printer, and the Extended
Firmware overlay `13-patch-rfid`, GPL-3.0, patches the same files. About a fifth of the lines our
FM175xx reader patch adds are lines that overlay adds too. In `openspool_mapper.py`, 22 lines are
that overlay's: they fill Snapmaker's own tray structure field by field, with the same defaults.
OpenRFID in that firmware is credited to @suchmememanyskill and the OpenSpool `subtype` field to
@morgendagen.

The rest of the reader code (`bespok3d_rfid.py`, `ntag_reader.py`, `ndef_parser.py`,
`mifare_classic.py`) is written from scratch.
